item.value: Using Concrete CMS, websites can be created easily and intuitionally. The administration of contents as well as the site's structure is handled via the frontend, in other words on the website itself.

From a small, straightforward homepage to a large-scale Internet presence: The field of application Joomla provides, is versatile. Joomla allows most diverse solutions and is outstanding in adjusting itself to users needs.

MODX is a free to use content management system (CMS) and application framework (CMF) to quickly and efficiently develop and administrate complex websites and applications.

TYPO3 is an efficient CMS and is outstanding in adjusting itself to most diverse and strongly customized needs. Especially when it comes to large-scale and complex web projects, Typo3 can fully unfold its advantages.

WBCE is a further development of the content management system WebsiteBaker. The open source CMS provides a contemporary backend, a high versatility and is easy to use.
With the free blog software FlatPress you can create your own blog quickly and easily - and without a database. Appearance and functionality can be customized with themes and plugins.

Wordpress is a versatile and easy to use blog software for creating and administrating websites. The graphical user interface (GUI) is user friendly and special skills regarding HTML, PHP or CSS are not needed.
MyBB is a free to use board software containing many features. The software is particularly characterized by its ease of handling.
The board software phpBB provides many options to individually create boards using numerous plugins and addons.
Using the open source software Lychee you are able to conveniently and securely manage photos and even entire photo albums and to share them publicly.
Piwigo (formerly PHPWebGallery) is a free software which allows you to create your own web photo galleries. Piwigo can be easily adjusted to your custom needs.
Setting up a professional online shop - it's easy to realize using the shop software PrestaShop. You have access to thousands of professional templates.
DokuWiki is an easy-to-use and extremely versatile wiki software. DokuWiki works on the basis of PHP and does not require a database.
The MediaWiki software is an open source Wiki software for gathering and recording experiences and knowledge.
Nextcloud allows you to easily and quickly create a cloud environment. Data can be obtained and transferred anytime and from anywhere as well as it can be shared with other users.
Always keep an eye on the current project status - it's no big deal with Kanboard, the easy to use project management software.
The bugtracking system Mantis Bugtracker can be used for detecting and logging errors as well as for the administration of feature requests.
For all website owners who stress web analysis and data protection, Matomo is an alternative solution to other analyzing tools. All data is stored on your own server.
phpMyFAQ is a multilingual, database-based and scalable FAQ system. It provides numerous features such as the management of users, groups, news, categories, FAQ entries and comments.
